notes.subject: khesed bilong ol
notes.rationale: חסדם: 'ol i lusim khesed bilong ol yet' (KJV/JPS) o 'ol i lusim olgeta bel bilong wosip long Elohim' (hafu bilong Hamas, 'relijun'), samting Yona i tokim long ol lain bilong en yet.

notes.subject: ol samting giaman
notes.rationale: הבלי שוא i stap tupela tok bilong 'nating' — 'win-wail olgeta', em i tok bilong ol piksa (Kisim Bek 32:8).

translation: Ol man i holimpas ol samting giaman no gat wankain, ol i lusim khesed bilong ol yet.
